entry.title: New: Resolution 94 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM THE DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT(S) AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT(S)

Transfers $451,221 from the Transfer to Housing Fund account to the HOME Program Income Repayment account to return funds that could not be applied towards the cost of building materials for two self-help affordable housing projects, due to those building projects being completed after the July 18, 2024, deadline.
